guest_layouts.packs: 007460D3 loads the aligned 135001 header as ESI; 007460B5 assigns aligned 135003 records to ESI+18; 007460FF..00746118 links ESI itself into B479D4. Live header+1c retains the record count. Records are 96 bytes: +0 hash, +4 kind, +7 enabled, +c RGB8, +10/+14/+18 XYZ, +1c outer radius, +30 inner radius, +3e bounded 34-byte name. Camera B4AF90+0 is the row-vector world-to-view transform, projection at +40. Primary world/depth handles are AB04F4/AB04F8; flow A99BBC=6.
